description: Johnson CAD certified data rolls: 2026 and a 2025 re-export as tab-delimited extracts, 2024 web extract, 2021 to 2023 CSV rolls. See docs/registry/sources/tx-johnson-cad.md.

sources.publisher: Central Appraisal District of Johnson County
sources.license: Public record (Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552); no license or terms of use stated for the roll files
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Downloads page re-read 2026-11-12 by the collector's identified client: no terms, click-through or login on the roll files; the only conditions are on the GIS shapefile ('Use of this data constitutes acceptance that ... JCAD makes no warranty as to the accuracy or completeness of the data'), which is not configured. robots.txt: WordPress default (Disallow /wp-admin/ only), no Content-Signal. Sizes and Last-Modified of the configured files checked by HEAD on 2026-11-12. The district moved to a new appraisal system in 2026: the 2026 certified roll and the 2025 re-export (posted 2026-05-07) are the tab-delimited extract read by tx_johnson; 2024 is the earlier system's web extract (WEBMAIN.CSV read for values only); 2021 to 2023 are CSV rolls not yet read. Supplemental, preliminary and BPP files on the page are not configured.
